#Dogecoin May Be Casino-Like Fun, But #Bitcoin Is Getting Serious --
Speculative crypto-asset excesses are evident, but Bitcoin is likely to maintain its price discovery and adoption into the mainstream. In just a few months, about 5x the average price of 2020 is impressive. https://t.co/0YBDSuBYmX

What stops tokenism of all assets?
How does the fair value of #Dogecoin compare to tokens tracking real assets, with income? If many of the millions of so-called #cryptocurrencies can easily lose about 3 zeros of value, seems lopping only one zero off #Bitcoin would show good

Silliness of 1929, 1999? #Dogecoin, the joke coin, could lop off three zeroes from market cap and still be silly expensive. The chart may show what it might mean for #Bitcoin/gold. There was one cryptocurrency in 2009 and now there's millions.
